description: Projects how long a student loan (HELP, HECS, VSL, SSL, TSL, SFSS) takes to repay with compulsory repayments, as the paycalculator.com.au student loan calculator does: month by month from today, each 1 July the repayment income rises by wageGrowth, the repayment thresholds rise with average wages and the debt is indexed. Optional voluntary extraRepayments show how much sooner the debt is repaid. Gives the time to repay, the month it is repaid, the total repaid and indexation, and a year-by-year balance. This is a projection on assumptions (listed in "assumptions") - say so. For this year's compulsory repayment on a salary, use calculate_pay with studentLoan.

extraRepayments.description: Voluntary repayments a year, on top of the compulsory repayments.

indexation.description: Debt indexation (% a year) - the lower of CPI and wage growth: 4.0% in 2024, 3.2% in 2025, 2.8% in 2026. Defaults to 2.5%.

repaymentIncome.description: Annual repayment income: taxable income plus reportable fringe benefits, reportable super contributions, net investment losses and exempt foreign income. Use details.studentLoanRepaymentIncome from calculate_pay (with studentLoan: true) when available, otherwise taxable income.

wageGrowth.description: How much the repayment income rises each year (%). Defaults to 3.5%, about average wage growth; higher for someone early in their career.

name: student_loan_repayment

thresholdIndexation.description: Rise in the repayment thresholds (% a year, average wages).

wageGrowth.description: Rise in the repayment income used (% a year).

debtRemaining.description: The debt left at the end of the projection (0 when repaid).

duration.description: Time to repay, e.g. "9 years and 5 months".

firstMonthlyRepayment.description: The compulsory repayment a month now.

notRepaid.description: Why the debt is not repaid, when paidOff is false.

paidOff.description: False when the debt is not repaid (see notRepaid).

paidOffMonth.description: The month the debt is repaid, e.g. "Mar 2036".

totalIndexation.description: Indexation added to the debt over the projection.

years.description: Each financial year of the projection; the first is the rest of this year.

debtAtEnd.description: The debt at the end of the year, or when it is repaid.

indexation.description: Indexation added on 1 July (0 in the first, part year).

title: Student loan repayment
